listing.name: Customizable Regalia
listing.summary: Yea, this. Makes Regalia from Tahlan Shipworks behave like Virtuous from Diable Avionics. Safe to add to existing save file, not safe to remove (duh). Enjoy your Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs with two energy weapons I guess.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the behavior of Regalia ships to match that of Virtuous ships.

description: Modifies Regalia units from Tahlan Shipworks so they function like Virtuous units from Diable Avionics. This allows Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs to utilize two energy weapons.
